headline: Rollout of VND 220,000 Billion Credit Package: Many Banks Cut Lending Rates for Businesses
summary: Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank and Agribank announced preferential credit packages for small and medium-sized enterprises under a VND 220,000 billion program, with several banks cutting lending rates.
why: Vietcombank, BIDV, VietinBank and Agribank are state-linked major Vietnamese lenders whose rate moves shape credit costs for businesses.
